summary: For Python 2.6 compatibility, str.format() placeholders must be numbered, since empty {} only works from 2.7.
questions: How should I write format strings for Python 2.6 compatibility?

answer_card.title: Use numbered str.format placeholders
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
# Fails on Python 2.6
"Dear {}, Welcome to {}".format(username, location)
# Works
"Dear {0}, Welcome to {1}".format(username, location)
```
